word: Quick to start  |  text: You start things early and without fuss, before any plan exists. Waiting feels like losing time, so you start the quick version ahead of the sure one. Start the way you do, and carry one start past where it stops being new.

word: Deal-maker  |  text: Seeing the opening before others see the wall is your standing advantage. Where most people need proof, you need one walk past the site, and the plan assembles itself uninvited. Most of what you imagine stays imaginary. The fraction you build pays for the whole habit.

options.text: word: Deal-maker  |  text: You walked past the empty lot once and the café appeared in your head, tables and all, a year before anyone else saw potential. By the time the neighborhood caught up, you had already moved on twice. Early is the only schedule you have ever kept.

word: Quick to start  |  text: Whenever something new opens, you start before asking what it takes. Starting feels like freedom, so you take the quick start ahead of the rest you are owed. Take the slow middle too, because every quick start costs you the rest you never take.

options.text: word: Deal-maker  |  text: Friends have learned to listen when you point at nothing and describe a business. Half your ideas sound absurd on the sidewalk and obvious five years later. The people who laughed at the first one quietly ask about the next.

word: Quick to start  |  text: Whatever you start has other people in it before the thing is real. You need movement more than certainty, so you start, move on and leave the middle open. Stay for one ending, because each start you share leaves them the middle to finish.

options.text: word: Open-handed  |  text: Money moves through your hands easily, and it keeps coming back with interest of a kind no bank tracks. You give without counting, on instinct, and the instinct has been running a quietly profitable book for years without ever once being audited.

word: Generous  |  text: You give before you count, and rarely regret it. Holding back feels like holding your breath, so you give to whoever needs it ahead of your own plans. Give one month a plan as well, because a plan is how your generosity lasts.

word: Generous  |  text: Giving comes more easily to you than keeping, especially money. Being generous keeps the world feeling wide, so you give away a good month rather than save it. Keep giving, and hold one part back, because what you keep is what the giving stands on.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_偏财 · catalyst · ledger[7] (cost self, row 3, The Horizon (偏财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Generous  |  text: Giving is your first answer to most things. Being generous feels more like you than being careful, so you give the extra ahead of putting any aside. Give yourself a part too, because the money you never keep is what giving costs you.

word: Open-handed  |  text: You covered the dinner without thinking, the way you seeded the friend’s shop and floated the cousin’s rent. Nobody kept a ledger, least of all you. Somehow the shop sends customers, the cousin sends leads, and generosity keeps turning out to be your best-performing account.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_偏财 · catalyst · ledger[8] (cost others, row 3, The Horizon (偏财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Generous  |  text: Whenever the people close to you run short, you give before being asked. Giving keeps you freer than being owed, so you give rather than build anything shared. Let them give back sometimes, since your giving takes from them the chance to be generous too.

word: Open-handed  |  text: The word on you is generous, and the word travels further than money does. Doors open because you propped one open for someone else two years back. Tight-fisted people never see this economy at all, and they keep wondering how you afford your luck.

options.text: word: Chases the new  |  text: The first week of anything is the one you chase. Since the new shows no flaws, you chase it ahead of finishing the old. You know by now that the new has the same flaws waiting, so chasing it costs more than finishing.

word: Chases the new  |  text: Whatever is newest in front of you is what you chase hardest. You have more Wood than strength behind it, so you chase the fresh start ahead of the finish. Keep in mind that the half-done thing behind you was once what you chased.

word: Scattered  |  text: Starting is your genuine talent, and staying is the tax you keep finding ways around. Your energy is all spring and no autumn: everything gets planted, nothing gets brought in, and the finish line remains a rumor from other people’s lives.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_偏财 · friction · ledger[1] (cost self, row 1, The Horizon (偏财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Chases the new  |  text: Where you are is rarely what you chase. Because staying feels like being stuck rather than home, you chase the far plan with hours the near one needed. Remember that each chase costs you the venture already begun, and half a venture pays nothing.

word: Scattered  |  text: Four projects, all around forty percent, none moving. The oldest one needed two weekends of work in March, and it is October, and those weekends went to the newest one, which has since also stopped. The finish line has never once seen you up close.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_偏财 · friction · ledger[2] (cost others, row 1, The Horizon (偏财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Scattered  |  text: People have stopped asking how the projects are going, because the answer is always the same word, almost. Your talent was never the question. What they are waiting for, some more patiently than others, is a single finished thing to point at.

word: Chases the new  |  text: Chasing the next thing keeps you alive. Since the new chance pulls more than the promised one, you chase it and leave the unfinished half to your partner. You promised them the middle as well as the start, remember, whatever you chase now.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_偏财 · friction · ledger[3] (drive, row 2, The Horizon (偏财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Spread thin  |  text: You spread over the next thing as easily as the first. Since every open option feels like safety, you spread across half chances rather than hold a whole one. Do not forget that chances come easily, and strength for one is what spreading costs.

word: Spread thin  |  text: Spreading yourself over several things feels normal, and one alone feels like being caught. Your Wood outruns the strength carrying it, so you spread across every open option rather than drop one. Remember how thin that spreads you, one body over all of them.

word: Overgrown  |  text: Adding commitments is a reflex you no longer notice, the way a hedge never notices new branches. Every yes seemed small at the moment of signing. The sum runs your life now, and the important thing keeps not happening inside a calendar too full to hold it.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_偏财 · friction · ledger[4] (cost self, row 2, The Horizon (偏财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Overgrown  |  text: There is no white space left in the calendar, and reading it honestly is uncomfortable: half the entries are things you volunteered for while already busy. Each one was one small yes. Together they are the reason the important thing keeps not happening.

word: Spread thin  |  text: You are spread among more things than your body keeps up with. Letting go feels like losing rather than choosing, so you spread yourself over them, tired at each one. Spread this thin, you never get a full rest, and that is worth remembering.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_偏财 · friction · ledger[5] (cost others, row 2, The Horizon (偏财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Overgrown  |  text: From outside, your life looks impressively full, and people say so with admiration. Up close, the fullness has no center. Even your closest people book you two weeks out, and the thing you say matters most has not appeared on the calendar in months.

word: Spread thin  |  text: Whenever something new asks for you, you spread yourself one slice thinner. Since closing an option feels like losing, you keep spreading rather than shut one. You hand your partner and family the same thin slice as everything else, and you know it.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_偏财 · friction · ledger[6] (drive, row 3, The Horizon (偏财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Fickle  |  text: Your interest burns hottest at the start and moves on before results arrive, and the pattern is old enough to have its own shelf. Enthusiasm was never the missing ingredient in any of it. Week seven is, and week seven always has been.

word: Spends freely  |  text: You spend money as if it were made to move. Money held back feels like life held back, so you spend it today rather than save for a day you have not met. You already know how early you spend the quiet months.

word: Spends freely  |  text: Unspent money feels less real to you than money already gone. Spending keeps life feeling open, so you spend an easy month rather than put any toward a slow one. Bear in mind that you meet the slow month too, with everything already spent.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_偏财 · friction · ledger[7] (cost self, row 3, The Horizon (偏财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Spends freely  |  text: With money, you spend sooner than you let it sit. Since spending feels like living and saving like waiting, you spend the month's money ahead of keeping any. You pay for the free spending in money never kept, as every thin month reminds you.

word: Fickle  |  text: The guitar got six good weeks, then the course got its six, then the market stall. Each one was the real thing while it lasted, and the shelf where they ended up is running out of space. Week seven has beaten you more often than any rival.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_偏财 · friction · ledger[8] (cost others, row 3, The Horizon (偏财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Fickle  |  text: Friends now respond to your new obsessions with a warmth they privately ration, because they have met week seven. Nobody doubts the passion. word: Spends freely  |  text: Spending on the people near you comes before your own next month. Helping them out feels better than keeping, so you spend on their short months rather than a shared cushion. Never forget that you spend their quiet months as well as your own.

options.text: word: Cultivating  |  text: Improving what you already own comes easier to you than chasing what you don’t, and it shows everywhere you’ve settled. Care, in your hands, behaves like an investment: whatever you maintain appreciates, and whatever needs chasing, you mostly no longer bother to chase.

word: Patient builder  |  text: Building slowly is where you feel most sure of yourself. You have more push than Wood to put it into, so you build one thing for years rather than chase several. Keep building at that pace, because the slow build is the one you keep.

word: Patient builder  |  text: What you build, you build to last, in no hurry. Since you want a thing to last more than arrive first, you build it for years ahead of starting another. Celebrate halfway through each build, because the years are the price you pay.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · catalyst · ledger[1] (cost self, row 1, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Cultivating  |  text: The bike you have oiled every spring for six years is one example, and the client you have kept for ten is the other. Neither looked like ambition at any point, and both are now worth double what they were. That is more growth than most of the chasing around you produced.

word: Patient builder  |  text: Whatever matters to you, you build for years. You put the built thing ahead of the wanted one, so you keep building what you have while your wish waits. Start building the wanted one too, because patience costs you the thing you never began.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · catalyst · ledger[2] (cost others, row 1, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Cultivating  |  text: Restless people find your patience confusing, and then they find it enviable. While they traded up and started over, you stayed and improved what was already yours, and the value quietly crossed over theirs somewhere around year five. Nobody saw the overtaking happen. It was too slow to watch.

word: Patient builder  |  text: You provide by building what lasts. Since you put finished ahead of shared, you build in private and keep the people near you waiting. Build one thing in plain sight, because the wait is the small price your care asks of them.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · catalyst · ledger[3] (drive, row 2, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Compounding  |  text: Small and repeated is your natural size of effort, and it is a better engine than it looks. You distrust bursts and believe in schedules, and the believing has paid: your results arrive the way interest arrives, invisibly for years, then suddenly.

word: Saves first  |  text: You save first and spend what is left, never as a sacrifice. Since money kept calms you more than money spent, you save before pleasure every time. Let pleasure win once in a while, because that is what the saving is for.

word: Saves first  |  text: Saving comes before spending for you, and you never decide it. Being covered means more than anything you would buy, so you save ahead of wanting. Spend a small part of what you save on yourself, because a cushion is also for sitting on.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · catalyst · ledger[4] (cost self, row 2, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Compounding  |  text: Fifty a month since college. A page a day, a call every Friday, and at no point did any of it look impressive, which is exactly why it worked. Your natural size of effort is small enough to repeat forever, and repetition is where your money and your skill actually come from.

word: Saves first  |  text: Your safety lives in what you have saved. Since you put feeling covered ahead of feeling alive, you save by postponing the small pleasures. Spend one of them on purpose, because saving first costs you the today you never have.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · catalyst · ledger[5] (cost others, row 2, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Saves first  |  text: Whenever the people at home want something, you are already saving. Safety together matters more than happiness today, so you put saving ahead of the wish. Say yes to one wish early, because you are asking them to put a life on hold.

word: Compounding  |  text: Watching you work is boring, and your results embarrass people who sprint. The deposits were too small to notice and too regular to stop, and somewhere along the way they became terrain. Friends who mocked the fifty a month now ask, carefully, how it got to this.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · catalyst · ledger[6] (drive, row 3, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Loyal  |  text: You stay loyal and count it as the love itself. Being someone's certainty feels better than being their surprise, so you keep being loyal ahead of being new. Be new for them sometimes, because you were chosen for more than your loyalty.

word: Loyal  |  text: Being loyal comes ahead of being exciting for you. Being known feels safer than being wanted, so you stay loyal on dull days as much as good ones. Surprise the one you are loyal to once a year, because the same days are loyalty's price.

word: Deep-rooted  |  text: Committing to one craft and one ground, and then actually staying, is the move you keep making. Depth beats breadth in every ledger you run, and the staying pays in ways the movers around you never collect. It looked stubborn for a while. Now it looks like strategy.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · catalyst · ledger[7] (cost self, row 3, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Deep-rooted  |  text: Year nine of the same work, same town, same name on the door. Around year four it felt like being left behind, because everyone else was rebranding and relocating. Then the people who kept moving started sending work to the one person who could still be found.

word: Loyal  |  text: Where you gave your word, you stay loyal after the reasons change. Loyalty feels more like love than choosing, so you stop asking whether this is what you want or promised. Ask yourself every few years, because loyalty costs you the love you never chose.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · catalyst · ledger[8] (cost others, row 3, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Loyal  |  text: Loyalty is how you love, given rather than said. You rate being loyal above speaking up, so you hand the person you keep your presence ahead of your feelings. Say it once in plain words, because unspoken loyalty leaves them guessing.

word: Deep-rooted  |  text: People who track one goal at a time find your calendar easy to read and your patience hard to copy. You are where you said you would be, doing what you said you would do, nine years in. Roots this deep never look like much from above. They hold anyway.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · friction · ledger[0] (drive, row 1, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Stays too long  |  text: Staying put is a choice you make without noticing. Since letting go feels like loss, you stay past the point a place feeds you rather than risk an empty one. You are paying for the stay, remember, in months that give nothing back.

word: Stays too long  |  text: Leaving comes hard to you, and you stay where the giving back stopped. You have more Wood than strength for it, so you stay rather than learn what leaving costs. Remember that staying costs you every month, in strength the place no longer returns.

word: Stuck  |  text: Outgrowing a place and staying anyway is a pattern of yours, and calling it loyalty stopped being accurate a while ago. The ground you hold has long since stopped feeding you. Holding it anyway is the habit, and the habit never checks the yield.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · friction · ledger[1] (cost self, row 1, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Stays too long  |  text: Where you settle, you stay, and settled is your word for stuck. Because the unknown costs you sleep, you stay with the known rather than the new. Bear in mind that staying on costs you the better love or pay you never looked for.

word: Stuck  |  text: The plant on your desk has been repotted twice in five years. The desk itself, the rate, and the commute have not moved once in the same stretch. You keep telling people you are settled, and some of them have started gently asking settled into what.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · friction · ledger[2] (cost others, row 1, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Stays too long  |  text: You stay in a love the way you stay anywhere. Since ending feels more like failing than choosing, you give your partner your staying instead of your honesty. Keep in mind that you owe them an honest answer more than a long stay.

word: Stuck  |  text: Recruiters gave up on you years ago, which you took as proof of loyalty. Meanwhile the colleagues who left keep getting bigger, and visiting their new offices leaves a taste you have stopped examining. Staying was right once. Nobody has re-run the numbers since.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · friction · ledger[3] (drive, row 2, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Counts everything  |  text: You count the price of most things, more than once. Since control feels like safety, you would rather count what something costs than learn its worth. Do not forget that counting is how you try to feel safe, and the sum never reads safe.

word: Plays it safe  |  text: Weighing a risk is your reflex, and almost no risk survives the weighing. The analysis is always excellent and always lands on later, because the math was never the real obstacle. The deciding was, and the deciding still is.

word: Counts everything  |  text: Counting what something cost matters more to you than enjoying it. Wood takes more from you than it gives, so you count what you have rather than use it. Remember, you started counting to never feel short, and no count has made you feel rich.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · friction · ledger[4] (cost self, row 2, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Counts everything  |  text: With money, you count before you feel. Because being caught short frightens you more than being bored, you count the cost instead of living the day. Never forget that you count to buy yourself ease, and ease is the one thing you have not bought.

word: Plays it safe  |  text: Three spreadsheets compared the two jobs down to the commute minutes, and the reply that finally went out was thanks, but not this year. The analysis took six weeks. The no took one sentence, and it was written somewhere in you before the spreadsheets ever opened.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · friction · ledger[5] (cost others, row 2, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Counts everything  |  text: For the people you love, you count as closely as yourself. A cost stays with you longer than a pleasure, so you count shared things aloud rather than let them pass. Remember how you count small pleasures away from them to cover your fear.

word: Plays it safe  |  text: People bring you opportunities gently, one at a time, with the exit left open. They already know the odds. Whatever it is, however good it is, the first answer will be some polite version of later, and later has its own way of becoming never.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · friction · ledger[6] (drive, row 3, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Slow to trust  |  text: You trust slowly, and the slow years are the test. Because being let down would cost more than staying alone, you wait for proof rather than trust first. You are waiting to trust on a guarantee love never gives, and you know it.

word: Inflexible  |  text: Once your way of doing things works, it hardens into the only way you will do them. Working once, for you, is proof of permanent correctness, and every update gets treated as an accusation. Your way still works. That was never the question people were raising.

word: Slow to trust  |  text: Trusting takes you years, losing it an afternoon. You carry more Wood than stamina to match, so you trust proof ahead of feeling. You know by now that you demand proof to avoid hurt, and waiting to trust is its own small hurt.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · friction · ledger[7] (cost self, row 3, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Inflexible  |  text: The new tool has been sitting unopened for a year, and the old one still technically works, which settles the argument every time it comes up. The argument keeps coming up. You have noticed that, and decided it means everyone else is wrong twice.

word: Slow to trust  |  text: Whenever you let someone new near, you take years to trust. Since a wrong guess feels worse than a lonely year, you hold out for proof ahead of trusting. Remember what proof costs you before you trust, closeness not had and years already gone.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/木_正财 · friction · ledger[8] (cost others, row 3, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Slow to trust  |  text: You make the people who love you prove it first. Trusting first feels like handing over the means to hurt you, so you ask for proof. You know already that you hand all the proving to the one you love while you wait to trust.

word: Inflexible  |  text: Working around you has become a small skill people teach each other. They know which suggestions to skip, which routines are load-bearing, and which sentence beginning with we have always means the conversation is over. Your way still works. It is just no longer the only thing being maintained.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/水_伤官 · catalyst · ledger[0] (drive, row 1, The Virtuoso (伤官)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Quick-witted  |  text: Wit is what you reach for first and would give up last. You want the quick true line said rather than the safe one, so silence costs you more than most people. Say the witty thing, and trust that you know when to hold it.

word: Silver-tongued  |  text: Words obey you the way water obeys gravity, finding every gap and pouring through beautifully. You talk people into things, out of things, and around things, and they enjoy the ride even when they can see the technique. Persuasion this smooth stopped being learned long ago. It flows.

word: Quick-witted  |  text: Your wit answers before your care does, and mostly you let it. Since being quick is how you know you are awake, you put the witty answer ahead of the careful one. Let the wit out, because you are kinder with it than you fear.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/水_伤官 · catalyst · ledger[1] (cost self, row 1, The Virtuoso (伤官)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Silver-tongued  |  text: The refund was against policy, the agent had said no twice, and four minutes into your version of events she was laughing and typing an exception. On the way out you tipped generously, which is your habit after winning. The technique pays its taxes.

word: Quick-witted  |  text: When talk gets hard, you reach the witty line before the honest one. You stay quick rather than get caught feeling something, so your wit lands where plain words belonged. Let plain words through, since each quick line costs you a piece of being known.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/水_伤官 · catalyst · ledger[2] (cost others, row 1, The Virtuoso (伤官)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Quick-witted  |  text: Saying the witty thing is how you take part. You get the laugh with the quick line rather than let one person finish, so you cost them being heard out. Hold the wit until their point lands, since your timing is good enough to wait.

word: Silver-tongued  |  text: Friends bring you along to negotiations the way people bring jumper cables, just in case. Sellers quote you one price and agree to another, later, unsure how the distance was crossed. The recordings would show nothing but pleasant conversation. That is the whole trick.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/水_伤官 · catalyst · ledger[3] (drive, row 2, The Virtuoso (伤官)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Inspired  |  text: Ideas arrive in you like spring water, from somewhere underground and always moving. Mid-shower, mid-sentence, mid-commute: the notion appears whole, strange, and usually good. You have learned to keep something to write with everywhere, including the glovebox and the shower wall.

word: Original  |  text: Doing a thing the usual way is nearly impossible for you, and only an original one feels done. Since you need things in pieces, you make your own version rather than follow the rule. Let originality count as talent, because it was never a fight.

word: Original  |  text: The usual way is the one way you cannot bring yourself to do a thing. You want the original more than approval, so you make the version you were not asked for. Keep making it, since the original is the one you are best at.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/水_伤官 · catalyst · ledger[4] (cost self, row 2, The Virtuoso (伤官)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Original  |  text: Nothing feels real to you until you have made it original. You take being wrong your own way ahead of being right theirs, so you redo finished work. Count the originals that worked, because you paid for the rest in hours you never owed.

word: Inspired  |  text: The campaign that carried the year was dictated into your phone at a red light, complete with the tagline, in ninety seconds. The agency had been circling it for a month. You apologized for the audio quality. Nobody heard the apology over the applause.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/水_伤官 · catalyst · ledger[5] (cost others, row 2, The Virtuoso (伤官)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Inspired  |  text: Colleagues have learned to schedule brainstorms around your presence, then pretend they did not. With you in the region, the whiteboard fills differently. word: Original  |  text: Making an original version of what you were handed shows you cared. You make someone's plan your own rather than follow it, so you deny them the small pride of a plan done as drawn. Carry one through unchanged sometimes, since your version can wait.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/水_伤官 · catalyst · ledger[6] (drive, row 3, The Virtuoso (伤官)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

Wood is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is the work your strength waits for. You carry less Wood than force to spend, so you chase an opening as much as you keep a steady love. You build best once you pick one and finish it, since the open one costs you the other.

options.text: Wood is your Action, and as a friction, it is growth that stops answering to the harvest. Effort goes wherever the roots or the branches already point, old ground held too hard, new shoots started too freely, and the season ends with plenty of motion and nothing ripe.

Wood is your Action, and as a friction, it is wanting that outruns the strength behind it. You carry more Wood than you have fuel for, so you reach for a new venture instead of finishing one. You hold savings and a steady love just as hard, until holding takes the strength that finishing needed.

label: ELEMENT_PAIR/金_木 · function.advise_catalyst · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.advise_catalyst

options.text: Growing things still need a gardener’s ruthlessness. Once a season, walk the whole field: feed what is fruiting, and let one dead project go without guilt. Keep the daily habits exactly as they are. And claim the growth out loud, raise the price, take the credit, sooner than feels polite.

You get hardest on yourself when your strength has nothing to build. Give it something. Agree to one venture before you are sure. Put a date on the saving you keep putting off. Fix one thing at home with your own hands, and write the first line of the plan tonight.

label: ELEMENT_PAIR/金_木 · function.advise_friction · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.advise_catalyst

options.text: You start more than your body has strength to finish. Sleep a full night before any new yes. Eat before you plan the next thing. Seek Metal, your own Body energy. Metal is what stays when the wanting stops, the rest under the effort. Let it hold what Wood pours out.

A field is judged at harvest, and yours keeps skipping the judging. Twice a year, walk the rows honestly: kill one dead thing out loud, feed the two that actually fruit, and spend one fenced-off risk on purpose. Judge every habit by its yield, and never by its years of service.

options.text: Metal feeds water, the old texts say: dew beads on the cold blade at dawn, drawn out of the air by the chill of the steel. The edge does not pour. It makes the water by being what it is, hard and cold and exact, and the drops gather on the clean line without any effort of its own. What the blade cannot say, the dew says for it, running off into the ground.

In the old reckoning water is metal's child: cold iron beads the morning dew, and metal, melted, runs bright as any river. The hard thing does not stay hard. At its finest edge it turns liquid, and what was fixed begins to flow, the clear stream carrying the mountain's sharpness out into the world.

options.text: Water is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is the care you hold back and the talent you keep quiet. Since you carry little Water, you judge more than you let flow. You want to be right more than heard, so you keep your kindness and your best ideas waiting too long.

Water is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is output that flows. Words, cooking, small kindnesses, the bright remark that turns an evening: whatever is inside you moves outward without forcing, and people are fed by it before they notice they were hungry.

Water is your Expression, and as a friction, it is care that never stops and talent that stays loud. You pour out more Water than you take in, until every thought gets said. You need to be heard more than refilled, so your care and wit run out before your words do.

options.text: Ease is a gift right up until it dodges every hard thing. Pick one piece of what you make and finish it to done, not to pleasant. Say the awkward true sentence once a week, to the person it belongs to. Comfort that never risks anything eventually feeds no one.

You keep being right in private, and that counts for nothing until someone hears it. Send the page before the third read. Tell a child one story with no lesson in it. Once a month, give something you made to someone who did not ask. Say the compliment the moment you think it.

options.text: A river with no banks is a swamp, even a pleasant one. Give your talent one container: one project, one hour, the same time every day. Let yourself be bothered on purpose by one thing that matters. And make the treat follow the work, never replace it.

You say the thing to find out what you think, and nothing is left over for you. Read a whole chapter before you answer. Sit with one question overnight. Seek Earth, the Mind energy. Earth is the bank and the ground: it takes water in and holds it until it clears. Let it hold what Water pours.

options.text: The refined prevails over the stubborn: fire alone commands metal. In the forge the unbending learns to bend, ore gives up its rock, and the blade takes whatever shape the flame decides. Heat is the one argument metal cannot win, and what survives the fire comes out finer than what went in.

Fire tames metal, the old texts say, and the forge softens the blade. Cold steel is hard and brittle, and only heat lets it take a shape it can keep. The smith holds the edge in the coals until it glows, works it while it is soft and cools it again. The fire gives the metal nothing it did not already have. It only decides what the metal is made into.

options.text: Fire is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is pressure that shapes your strength. You take in more fuel than you spend, so you look for a crisis to meet as much as a standard to hold your career to. You finish more under a rule you never wrote than under your own.

Fire is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is structure with heat in it. Pressure organizes you instead of scattering you, rules turn into momentum, and when things fall apart you are the one holding a straight line through the middle of it.

Fire is your Order, and as a friction, it is order with the thermostat broken. Every rule runs hot, every moment gets treated like an emergency, and the structure that held things up presses down on people, then hardest on you. Nobody judges the edge as harshly as you do.

You do your best work when someone is allowed to tell you no. Pick one job this month that comes with a deadline and a judge, and ship it on time. Make the hard call out loud in front of the people it affects. Finish one small thing before anyone has to chase you for it.

options.text: You answer to pressure faster than you recover from it. Read the whole message before you answer the next hard call. Keep one evening a week with nobody to report to. Command works best rationed. Before taking over, ask one question and wait for the whole answer. Rank the week’s fires and let the bottom three burn out alone. Schedule the rest before the crash schedules it for you. Order people can breathe in is the only kind that holds.

options.text: Metal answers metal, the old texts say: strike one blade and the one beside it rings at the same pitch. Steel is sharpened on steel, two edges ground together taking a finer line than either could reach alone. Nothing yields in that meeting. Iron piled on iron grows heavier, and an edge with no softer thing to meet has nothing left to cut except its own kind.

Like answers like, the classics say: the same note struck twice rings once, and louder. When metal stands beside metal there is no reaction, only reinforcement, ore of one seam, edges off one forge. Such sameness is strength and its own hazard. Two blades in one sheath keep each other keen, or wear each other blunt.

Metal is your Body, and running thin, it is the reserve everything else draws on: sleep, food, recovery, the physical base under your discipline. Yours holds form long after the fuel is low, so you notice depletion late.

label: ELEMENT_PAIR/金_金 · function.definition_friction · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.definition_catalyst

Metal is your Body, and running over, it is more physical force than your life currently spends: discipline with no outlet, stamina turning into tension you carry in your shoulders and jaw.

label: ELEMENT_PAIR/金_金 · function.advise_catalyst · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.advise_catalyst

options.text: Discipline that skips recovery is borrowing, and the interest is physical. Put maintenance on the calendar before it is needed: fixed bedtime, real meals, one full rest day a week. Track energy like money for one month. Treat the first sign of wear as a warning.

You treat rest as something you earn after the work instead of the thing the work runs on. Take rest in first and sleep before the hard decision rather than after it. Let one peer carry a job you could do yourself. Sit out one contest a month on purpose. Eat before you answer the message.

options.text: A body built for effort needs effort to be at peace. Give it a hard weekly outlet, lifting, long walks, manual work. Pair every sitting-heavy day with something physical. When patience runs short, train first and talk after.

Being right is how you stay in charge of yourself. Ship one finished thing to someone above you by their date. Say your plan to someone who can refuse it. Seek Fire, the Order energy. Fire is heat with a deadline: it gives your force a direction and a judge. Let it spend what Metal stores.
